regions.merged_text: Arthur Robert Roath, age 15, of 3124 East Hancock, discharded from Sanitorium at Northville after 10 months declared cured of T.B., but very weak in action of heart, bad cold now two weeks, enrolled this evening for year - "Hardning of inner valve of heart." said to be the trouble - Father Catholic, Mother & P.S. Boy wants to be a Catholic "Says con- Children Baptists. scientious mother. "Do you think he realizes what it means?" July 17th Boy and Parents come to Monastery to express gratude for manifest improvement living now 5341 Mt. Elliott. Thanks be to God - May He direct us all! March 17 (1926) Boy reported as in ideal condition. Now living on Van Dyke near 7 Mile road.

regions.merged_text: Big Company Enrolled. - Chevrolet Thursday Feb. 12th 8 P.M. "Father ... I don't know what I am going to do." said John McKenna, a friend, and zealous promoter of S.M. Association. "I have not had a full day in two weeks, and To-day I got less than two hours." A short pause and McKenna resumes, as by inspiration: "Father put the company in the Mass Association. I smiled a moment, sure it was an introduction of something new; then agreed, knowing "it must bring a blessing of some kind. The Chevrolet Company is en- rolled for year, at the time producing 65-70 machines per hour when running rightly. Feb. 13th Company is reported to have order for 45000 machines in 30 days. March 12 - Exactly 4 weeks later 300, per hour was output.
